name: 404 Redirect to Homepage or Custom URL
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
🚀 Effortlessly redirect all 404 errors to your homepage or any custom URL (including external links) with this lightweight plugin. Perfect for:

✔ SEO optimization – 301 redirects preserve search rankings
✔ Improved user experience – No dead ends for visitors
✔ Flexible redirection – Works with any URL (internal/external)
✔ Simple setup – Just enable and set your target URL

Key Features:
• Toggle redirection on/off with one click
• Set any destination URL (WordPress page, post, or external site)
• No configuration needed – works out of the box
• GDPR compliant – no user data collected

🔗 Plugin by DominoPress – WordPress solutions for professionals.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin via WordPress admin or install directly from the repository
  2. Activate under Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Configure under Settings → 404 Redirect
sections.faq:
Will this affect my SEO?

Yes – in a positive way! 301 redirects tell search engines the page has moved permanently, preserving your rankings better than 404 errors.

Can I redirect to external websites?

Absolutely! Enter any valid URL (e.g., https://example.com) in the redirect field.
